subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers refresh and narrow the active linked PR, or replace it with a fresh current-main Discord media fix before closing this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the open fix PR is conflicting and has proof/contract blockers, so automation should not close the issue or queue a competing fix without deciding the PR path.

options.title: Refresh and narrow linked PR
options.body: Keep the contributor branch canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve any broader media/API contract changes, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale/conflicting branch only after a new narrow PR carries over the useful MIME and animation-preservation fix with credit and proof.

options.title: Leave issue parked
options.body: Keep the issue open as the canonical tracker until maintainers have bandwidth to resolve the linked PR path.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor branch canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve any broader media/API contract changes, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send path and shared media loading surface involved in the decision.
